name: steam-plugin
description: Look up any Steam game from your editor: US store price, live player count, review score, and latest news. No API key.
long_description: A zero-dependency Node.js MCP server (Node 18 or newer) that calls Steam's public, unauthenticated endpoints. Tools: search_games, get_game, get_player_count, get_reviews, and get_news. Prices are from the US store. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Valve Corporation.

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search the Steam store by name; returns [{appid,name,price}] (US prices).

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Store details for a Steam app: price (USD), release date, devs, genres, platforms, description.

tools.name: get_player_count
tools.description: Current concurrent players for a Steam app.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Steam user review summary (all languages): score description and positive/negative totals.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Latest news/announcements for a Steam app (excerpts up to 300 chars).
